measurement_basis: Control tool schema regression verification and source content reference

observation.source_interface: MNCS Control MCP Git branch tools

outcome.implementation_change: Tool descriptions for worktree add/prepare, create branch, checkout, merge, pull, and push state the short branch-name contract. MCP schema regression coverage verifies the descriptions are present.
outcome.effectiveness_assessment: tool-description and schema contract verified; agent discovery and later live use not yet observed
outcome.analysis_limit: This refinement improves capability discoverability but makes no claim that agents have used the new guidance or that the historical push failure has the same root cause.

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

improvement_relation.basis: Control now rejects namespace-prefixed branch arguments at its branch-oriented service boundaries and presents the short-name rule in all seven affected MCP tool descriptions. A protocol-level regression test checks the live tool list descriptions.
improvement_relation.effectiveness_assessment: implementation and immediate tool-schema behavior verified; agent discoverability and recurrence after change not assessed
not_measured: cross-agent discovery of the branch-name contract
future live push and merge operation outcomes
whether the clearer tool descriptions change agent behavior
whether later agents avoid the malformed input
